<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Get user events (POST)"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/api/v1.0/events/for/{UserId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns events associated with a specific user, with support for request-body filters. Use this POST variant when you need to apply complex filtering beyond the legacy GET query parameters.

**Prerequisites**
1. **UserId** - Use [POST /api/v1.0/users](/docs/api/users/search-users) and extract `Items[].UserId`.

**Workflow Example**
1. Search for the user: [POST /api/v1.0/users](/docs/api/users/search-users) -&gt; extract `Items[].UserId`.
2. Build a filter body (optional): `GetEventsRequest.Filters`.
3. Fetch events: [POST /api/v1.0/events/for/\{UserId\}](/docs/api/events/get-user-events-post).

**Minimal Required Fields**: UserId (path). Filters are optional.
